scope_outcomes.criterion: A cross-document case comparison requires a justified common criterion, equivalent case identity and scope, and retained verbatim anchors from each distinct source.
scope_outcomes.basis: The sources examine state strategies in reshaping private networks: AUKUS through regulatory control and industrial policy, subsea cable network through private network realignment. A cross-document finding was added (V.CORPUS.F1) with verbatim anchors from both documents.
limitations: The comparison is limited to state strategy types; other dimensions such as venture capital or bipartisanship are not cross-documented.
The findings are based on conceptual claims, not quantitative outcomes.
Coverage is partial; only the sections needed for the anchor extraction were inspected in detail.
scope_outcomes.review_basis: Verified verbatim anchors from both sources support the cross-document finding. The aukus anchor captures the enmeshment of regulatory, industrial and defence policy; the subsea anchor captures the concept of private network realignment.

evidence_state.coverage_basis: reader/reviewer report; source bytes do not establish inspection or completeness
blocking_issues: Retained finding has missing or unexpected dimension identity; its scope cannot be assigned
